capabilities: Enable or disable whole groups with one click or command
Delay group loading after Obsidian startup
extras: README lists specific plugins that break or glitch with delayed loading (Pane Relief, Hidden Folder, Media Extended, Kanban, Outliner) and warns plugins that depend on each other should go in separate groups; manual installation is described because it was not yet in the community plugin repository.
problem: Obsidian enables or disables plugins one at a time and loads all enabled plugins at startup, which makes bulk management and fast startup difficult.
summary: Plugin group manager that lets you enable or disable multiple plugins at once and delay their startup to speed up Obsidian.
